summary: Stages of the lab order workflow.
purpose: Define which stages every job sent to a lab (prostheses, crowns, aligners…) goes through, in what order, and after how many days in a stage the order is considered overdue.
tips: There must be exactly one initial stage (every new order starts there) and at least one final stage (for example Completed or Cancelled).
A stage that has or had orders is not deleted: it is deactivated. If it still has orders, you choose which stage they move to.
Stage names are written by the clinic and are not translated.
Nothing applies until you press Save.
Each stage can notify when an order enters it and on time in stage (when it goes over its overdue days), in the app, by email or by WhatsApp. Alerts also go to the Alert Center.

config.lab-stages.section.active.label: Active stages
config.lab-stages.section.active.description: One row per stage, in workflow order: drag them by the handle on the left. Each has a color, name, type (initial, intermediate or final) and the number of days after which an order in that stage is overdue (empty = no limit; final stages have none).

config.lab-stages.section.inactive.label: Deactivated stages
config.lab-stages.section.inactive.description: Stages no longer in use that do not show on the board. They can be reactivated.

config.lab-stages.section.issues.label: Review the configuration
config.lab-stages.section.issues.description: What is missing before you can save: a single initial stage, at least one final stage, and complete, unique names.

config.lab-stages.btn.add.label: Add stage
config.lab-stages.btn.add.description: Adds an intermediate stage before the final ones.

config.lab-stages.btn.save.label: Save
config.lab-stages.btn.save.description: Saves the whole configuration at once. If a stage with orders was deactivated, its orders move to the chosen stage at that moment.

config.lab-stages.btn.alerts.label: Alerts
config.lab-stages.btn.alerts.description: Opens the stage alerts. The number shows how many are set up.

config.lab-stages.section.alert-enter.label: On entering the stage
config.lab-stages.section.alert-enter.description: Notifies every time an order moves into this stage. Choose who (roles, users, the order doctor or its creator) and which channel.

config.lab-stages.section.alert-dwell.label: Time in stage
config.lab-stages.section.alert-dwell.description: Notifies when the order goes over the stage overdue days; once or every X days while it stays. Only for non-final stages with a limit.
